```{r}
here::i_am("Charm-Prices.Rproj")
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Inputs

```{r}
stations_communes <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "stations_communes.csv"),
                              col_types = cols(id = "c", cp = "c", commune = "c"))
oil <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "oil.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Build the final dataset, one year at a time

One row = one station x fuel x day. Each price gets its station's commune and income (joined by `id`) and the oil price of that day (joined by `date`).

```{r}
#| eval: false
build_final <- function(year) {
  read_csv(here("data", "clean", paste0("prices_daily_", year, ".csv.gz")),
           col_types = cols(id = "c", fuel = "c", date = "D", price = "d")) %>%
    filter(fuel %in% c("Gazole", "E10", "SP98")) %>%
    left_join(stations_communes %>%
                select(id, commune, motorway, median_living_standard, poverty_rate),
              by = "id") %>%
    left_join(oil %>% select(date, brent_eur_l), by = "date") %>%
    mutate(brent_eur_l = round(brent_eur_l, 4),
           spread      = round(price - brent_eur_l, 4)) %>%
    write_csv(here("data", "clean", paste0("final_dataset_", year, ".csv.gz")))
}

walk(2021:2023, build_final)
```

## Check

```{r}
files <- here("data", "clean", paste0("final_dataset_", 2021:2023, ".csv.gz"))
tibble(file = basename(files), size_mb = round(file.size(files) / 1e6, 1))
```

```{r}
final_2022 <- read_csv(files[2], col_types = cols(id = "c", fuel = "c", commune = "c"))

final_2022 %>%
  summarise(rows       = n(),
            no_commune = sum(is.na(commune)),
            no_income  = sum(is.na(median_living_standard)),
            no_brent   = sum(is.na(brent_eur_l)))
```
